description: Trigger evaluation table for StudyHub AI Skills. Each skill has 3 positive triggers that must fire it, and 9 negative triggers (from its 3 sibling skills) that must not.

skills.name: Exam Prep
positive_triggers: I have my CAT 2 exams next week, can you quiz me with past paper questions from module 3?

Give me the most repeated questions asked in previous years for Operating Systems
negative_triggers: Turn these lecture notes on database normalization into an Anki flashcard deck
